outliers.title: Anita Alvarez Turned a Poolside Rescue Into a New Air Force Chapter #short #storytrending
outliers.description: One moment in the pool changed the course of Anita Alvarez’s story. During the 2022 World Aquatics Championships in Budapest, the American artistic swimmer lost consciousness underwater after her routine. Her coach, Andrea Fuentes, immediately dove in and brought her to the surface. Alvarez later returned to competition, helping Team USA earn silver at the 2024 Paris Olympics. In January 2025, she graduated from U.S. Air Force basic training and joined its World Class Athlete Program, allowing her to continue competing while serving.
